tools.name: clear_colors
tools.description: Removes view color overrides from elements in a category.

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Closes the active Revit document, optionally saving changes.

tools.name: color_splash
tools.description: Applies view color overrides to elements grouped by a parameter value.

tools.name: execute_revit_code
tools.description: Executes supplied IronPython code in Revit with the Windows user's permissions after review in Revit; code can access model data, files and network services.

tools.name: get_current_view_elements
tools.description: Lists elements visible in the active view, with optional level and location information.

tools.name: get_current_view_info
tools.description: Reads the active view's properties and settings.

tools.name: get_revit_model_info
tools.description: Reads project metadata, element counts, rooms, views, sheets, warnings and linked-model information.

tools.name: get_revit_status
tools.description: Reads bridge health and active document availability.

tools.name: get_revit_view
tools.description: Exports a named model view as a PNG image.

tools.name: launch_revit
tools.description: Starts an installed Revit version, optionally opens a model file, and checks bridge readiness.

tools.name: list_category_parameters
tools.description: Lists element parameters and sample values for a category.

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: Lists loaded family types with optional name filtering.

tools.name: list_family_categories
tools.description: Lists categories of loaded families.

tools.name: list_levels
tools.description: Lists model levels and their elevations.

tools.name: list_revit_installations
tools.description: Lists installed Revit versions and their executable locations.

tools.name: list_revit_instances
tools.description: Lists running local Revit instances with their stable selectors (A = port 48884, B = 48885, ...), Revit version and active document.

tools.name: list_revit_views
tools.description: Lists exportable model views grouped by view type.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Opens a specified Revit document, optionally auditing or detaching it from central.

tools.name: place_family
tools.description: Places a loaded family instance at specified coordinates and sets requested properties.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Saves the active document in place or to a specified new file.

tools.name: sync_with_central
tools.description: Synchronizes the active workshared model with central using requested relinquish options.

autodesk_apis_used: Revit API - Document and project information, levels, rooms, elements and parameters
Revit API - Views, sheets, ImageExportOptions and view graphic overrides
Revit API - Family symbols, family instance placement and Transactions
Revit API - OpenAndActivateDocument, Document.Close, Save, SaveAs and SynchronizeWithCentral
Revit API - User-supplied IronPython can invoke additional APIs under user review
